channel.title: Sports Talk Florida - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Sports Talk Florida (sportstalkflorida.com)

item.title: Tom Brady has a great day in Flag Football
item.description: Tom Brady opened strong, but Team USA dominated the Fanatics Flag Football Classic in Los Angeles. With help from Associated Press reporting, here’s how the national team overwhelmed NFL stars ahead of the 2028 Olympic debut.

item.title: Rays look to compete in tough AL East
item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays enter 2026 as a real contender in the AL East, pushing into the same competitive tier as the Red Sox and Orioles. Here’s why Tampa Bay has a clear path to the playoffs in MLB’s toughest division.

item.title: USF looks to hire a new head basketball coach soon
item.description: The USF’ coaching search begins with “unprecedented” interest, according to CEO Rob Higgins. Here are the top early candidates to replace Bryan Hodgson and why the job has become one of the hottest in college basketball.

item.title: Florida is stunned by Iowa end Championship repeat dreams
item.description: Iowa stunned defending champion Florida in the final seconds and Miami lost earlier in the day, leaving USF, UCF, Miami, and Florida all eliminated before the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament.

item.title: Matt Fitzpatrick Battles Back to Win Valspar Championship
item.description: Matt Fitzpatrick captures the Valspar Championship with a clutch birdie on 18, bouncing back from last week’s Players Championship loss.

item.title: Movsar Evloev on verge of title shot after beating Lerone Murphy at UFC London - Sports Talk Florida
item.description: Movsar Evloev turned the UK crowd upside down after beating the British fighter Lerone Murphy on his home turf at UFC London.

item.title: NCAA Sweet 16 Has Plenty of Marquee Matchups
item.description: The NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 is set with Duke vs St. John’s leading Friday’s slate and Texas, Purdue, Illinois, Houston, UConn, and Michigan State all featured in prime matchups.

item.title: NBA Power Rankings: Miami and Orlando Headed in Different Directions
item.description: The NBA playoff push is heating up as Oklahoma City stays No. 1, San Antonio surges, and the Heat and Magic stumble in a pivotal Week 23 Power Rankings update.

item.title: USF will land another winner in basketball and soon
item.description: USF’s coaching job has surged into national prominence thanks to major investments, rising success, and unprecedented interest from top candidates across college basketball.

item.title: Rays have a good mix of young and old players in 2026
item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays’ 2026 depth chart features rising prospects, new pitching additions, and a revamped outfield as fans look ahead to a pivotal season in St. Petersburg.
